requirements.text: Patients must be able to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments online.
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online.
Patients must have secure online access to test results after clinician review.
The portal must be user-friendly, especially for less tech-savvy patients.
The system must comply with GDPR and ensure data security.
Patients must be able to view available time slots for appointments.
Patients should be able to filter appointment types when booking.
Patients must receive automated confirmations via email or text after booking an appointment.
The system must allow patients to flag urgent symptoms during the booking process.
The portal must integrate with existing practice management software without requiring full data migration.
Staff training must be minimal, requiring only a short onboarding session.
The portal must be available 99.9% of the time during clinic hours.
Patients must have a section for repeat prescriptions where they can see current medications.
Patients must be able to select medications for refill requests and review selections before submission.
The system must allow patients to add notes or comments about their prescriptions.
Prescription requests must be securely sent to the practice for review before processing.
Patients must receive notifications when their prescriptions are ready.
